outcome_summary: Delivered a three-layer contextual guidance system for the DiffWindow: a color-coded recommendations sidebar (5 risk-rated materialDesign:Card elements driven by ViewModel computed properties), per-item tooltips on all 5 change-type icons, and a risk-gated confirmation dialog with singular/plural locale-aware messaging for removals and insertions. All 28 new locale keys are fully translated across 8 locales; the test suite ends at 492 passing / 0 failing / 2 intentionally skipped. One rework cycle resolved a Dispose() null-guard defect in the ViewModel test-seam constructor.
project_summary: Add a recommendations sidebar panel to the DiffWindow that displays contextual guidance about the consequences of detected load order changes, including risk-coded cards for each change type. Per-item tooltips on change type icons and a risk-gated confirmation dialog on "Accept Changes" provide defense-in-depth guidance at three interaction stages: passive browsing, hovering, and committing.
